title: OpenAI denies firing researchers over AI safety warnings
description: OpenAI has addressed the dismissal of three former safety researchers who voiced concerns over artificial intelligence safety. The company clarified that these terminations stemmed from a breach of trust rather than safety matters. The researchers highlighted alarming changes in corporate culture regarding safety priorities. Moving forward, OpenAI intends to establish contracts with independent safety assessors, as the conversation around AI safety remains polarized among industry experts.
